title: Atlas DataFlow Dataset Public Profile Publication Record
description: Deterministic Visible Publicly setting for a dataset, decoupled from the immutable published profile snapshot (contracts/dataset-public-profile-snapshot.schema.json). One publication record file exists per dataset_slug; setting visibility again replaces it deterministically, not as a growing history. This record controls whether an existing published snapshot may be exposed on public routes; it never controls publishing itself, never changes release package availability, and never carries presentation, contract, model, or metric content.

schema_version.title: Publication Record Schema Version
schema_version.description: Semantic version of this publication record schema structure in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format. Independent from contracts/dataset-public-profile-snapshot.schema.json's own schema_version.

dataset_slug.title: Dataset Slug
dataset_slug.description: Primary identity of the dataset this publication record applies to. Must match the registry slug pattern.

visible.title: Visible Publicly
visible.description: Whether this dataset's published profile snapshot may currently be exposed on public routes. Does not affect whether a snapshot exists, and never changes release package availability.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last write to this publication record.
